summary: On paper Dallas has the edge (Dallas' defense ranks 27th in explosive play rate, 8.9% allowed). Under center, Dak Prescott ranks 14th of 26 in EPA per dropback and Jalen Hurts ranks 17th; x-factor: CeeDee Lamb gets 29% of Dallas' targets and 36% of its air yards, and Philadelphia's pass defense ranks 16th. The model favors Dallas at 64%, mostly on rushing matchup (2.9 pts) and offensive injuries (1.1 pts).
